//: Voidashi. This file did not exist before -- swaync ran entirely on /etc/xdg defaults, so nothing here was a deliberate choice. Values that match the upstream default are still written out where the guide has an opinion about them, so a future default change cannot silently move the theme.
//positioning: Top right, under the bar, matching where the bar's own notification module sits.
//density: Standard density per RICE-GUIDE.md, 'Notifications'. Narrower than the 500px default: a notification is a glance, not a document.
//motion: 200ms is the notification-enter figure from RICE-GUIDE.md's motion table.
//timeouts: Critical never auto-dismisses -- an urgency that disappears on its own was not urgent. Low clears fastest.
